adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/loading.html.erb the script unconditionally calls `document.location.reload()` every 30000ms with no stop condition. When `EmbedController#best` can’t find a `topic_id` it renders this loading page and *also* enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` on every request. So if retrieval/import keeps failing (or is slow), each viewer will generate repeated requests and repeated job enqueues indefinitely (at least every 30s), even though the job itself may throttle retrieval via `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`.
